soundness_flags.label: def:gaussian-experiment; qalpha; Pi; all downstream power theorems
soundness_flags.one_line: A retained pair j=(C,s) carries a full two-stratum cell C, but the Gaussian quantile and power formulas condition only on X_s>c_s and J is not formally restricted to C_s=1; define the full signed cell event (or explicitly prove and encode its factorization) before claiming these are the selected-cell laws.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 2 gives the conditional selective randomization distribution and computable p-value under its assumptions; Section 5 identifies hold-out allocation and powerful selection-dependent statistics as future directions.

The article represents discretized sequential policies by trajectory variables and optimizes expected sample size subject to power and familywise-error constraints through a sparse-program formulation.
The cited results give vector finite-population CLTs for random partitions and completely randomized experiments.
The paper derives Berry--Esseen bounds for linear and quadratic functions of linear permutational statistics and develops design-based variance estimators.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 46, 2018
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves a selective central-limit transfer under independent sampling and randomized selection.

source_verification_receipts.version: author preprint corresponding to Advances in Mathematics 331, 2018
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work states the Ehrhard--Borell inequality and gives a systematic classification of its equality cases.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and stated design-based rank-estimator asymptotic scope
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies design-based properties of Rosenbaum rank estimators, including constant-effect and heterogeneous-effect settings.
The paper studies optimal conditional inference in batched adaptive Gaussian experiments and identifies an additional linear statistic under location-invariant adaptation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the scalar selection event in qalpha and Pi with the complete signed event determined by C, restrict J to active pairs with C_s=1, and state the required cross-stratum independence/factorization that reduces the full conditional law to the displayed one-dimensional integral.

Supply the two-component-uniform-mixture witness as an explicit primitive construction with mixture weights, supports, stratum allocation, and interval-verified A, b1, b2, and kappa values, rather than only asserting its existence.

Make the design contribution operationally stronger by deriving a finite-sample or asymptotic optimality certificate for the selected holdout rule from observable pilot primitives, including how primitive uncertainty propagates into the set-valued recommendation.

recommended_next_step: Revise the selected-cell conditioning and active-cell definition, then return this field-tier design-based frontier for novelty re-review.
